name: Group members and owners
description: Lists the members and owners of named distribution, mail-enabled security and Microsoft 365 groups, each with the exact address and object ID Exchange returned.

parameters.name: Group
parameters.label: Groups
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases of the groups to list.

parameters.name: MaxMembers
parameters.label: Maximum entries per group
parameters.help: Stops after this many members (or owners) of one group and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Members are identified by the address and object ID Exchange returned; an entry with neither is Unresolved. Names are shown for reading only and never used to match.
A distribution group's owners are returned as names. Each is Resolved only when Exchange finds exactly one recipient whose name, alias, address or ID is that value; otherwise it is Unresolved.
Nested groups are listed as members, not expanded. Dynamic distribution groups are not expanded and are marked NotExpanded.
Each group's members and owners are read up to the limit; a fuller list is marked partial.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
